content:
本模組包依據 LabPBR 標準，為 Farmer's Delight 添加了法線、視差、反射、自發光與次表面散射效果。
使用本模組包前，請先閱讀 [SPBR](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/spbr)![次表面散射](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b0c48cc66929977ed015a1ae3c45c5517f656017.jpeg) 的注意事項；建議搭配 [SPBR](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/spbr)![法線、反射與視差](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/546cd1bd3681068871cdc0d59fd1383bedd327d2_0.webp)![次表面散射](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c8cf51f42ed3f465b376c2c0c32b94decfe3ac8_0.webp)![重新製作模型](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9d19a61b89a607ce55869860c82b1110b48381e0.jpeg)![法線與視差](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a6c5c8a703c23104052cbdfe35eef21cea4560a.jpeg)![法線與視差](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8110e06119c17413ed21ed1b7e8a460aa7c1fd5c.jpeg) 一同使用。
